title: Anna Athina — direction + storyboard
scope: 2D planning board, not a rendered or collision-tested 3D previs

stages.title: The site, before the building
stages.state: Earthmoving and trench/form preparation. No invented piles or basement.
stages.camera: Low exterior start; short rise to read the actual footprint.
stages.transition: A quiet site surface and footprint establish in place; no logo morph.
stages.focus: Human scale; an actual place, not a floating object.
stages.confidence: Observed early state; earth profile schematic

stages.title: A concrete ground plane
stages.state: Broad A ground/base slab and early support indications; B base timing not asserted.
stages.camera: Dolly along the street-facing edge; lift just enough to see voids and footprint.
stages.transition: Unfinished slab becomes legible in place; no simulated foundation system.
stages.confidence: Ground pour observed; L1 mapping provisional

stages.title: B wing leads
stages.state: B solid walls/core and stacked working tiers dominate. A remains low with deck preparation.
stages.camera: Track beside B; open the composition toward the lower, broader A side.
stages.transition: Reveal B structural subsets before A upper structure. Solid walls develop with the structure, not all at the end.
stages.focus: The defining asymmetry of this real build.
stages.confidence: High B-ahead confidence; exact completed B floor count unresolved

stages.title: The transfer deck is prepared
stages.state: Broad A formed/reinforced deck with major openings; B/connection remains above it.
stages.camera: Dolly toward A, then a modest crane over its edge; stay outside unsupported interior spaces.
stages.transition: Minimal temporary deck-top/formwork state on the existing transfer outline. Voids stay open.

stages.title: The transfer pour
stages.state: A transfer slab resolves to concrete while the advanced B state holds.
stages.camera: Continue the same shallow elevated move; no interruption for a video montage.
stages.transition: In-place surface/state reveal; do not claim a measured pour direction. Remove temporary top state only after concrete is present.
stages.confidence: Transfer pour explicitly identified in existing footage

stages.title: A catches up; the form emerges
stages.state: A upper slabs, supports and solid enclosure progress; remaining B structure completes. Balcony concrete belongs with its supporting floor.
stages.camera: Rise along the angled A end; use successive slab edges as foreground parallax.
stages.transition: Undated architectural compression between evidenced endpoints. Never present an exact invented pour programme.
stages.focus: The asymmetry becomes one recognisable building.
stages.confidence: End state observed; intermediate order schematic

stages.title: Curves, roof and rooftop shell
stages.state: Curved concrete bands, staggered roof profiles, access mass, raised terrace and pool shell. No water or final coping yet.
stages.camera: Shallow crane inward in framing, physically outside the building; reveal A/B roof stagger and shell.
stages.transition: Concrete edge form develops with structure; roof and shell resolve without airborne parts.
stages.confidence: Advanced shell observed; individual roof/pool installation sequence unknown

stages.title: Architecture becomes complete
stages.state: Glazing, final façade response, screens, balustrades, terrace finish, coping and water.
stages.camera: Descend gently along the positive-Z exterior toward a wider completed composition.
stages.transition: Zone-level enclosure/finish transition into the exact frozen look. No new palette or lighting state.
stages.confidence: Finished appearance verified; installation order not documented

stages.title: Completed Anna Athina
stages.state: All 35 groups restored exactly to the approved visual endpoint; temporary construction states absent.
stages.camera: Small composed drift; allow roof, bands and glazing to be read together.
stages.transition: Hold the completed architecture; no new effect.

stages.title: Return to human scale
stages.camera: Descend around the open B end, turn gently eastward, and enter the exact approved path start and tangent.
stages.transition: Continuous exterior connection; this approach is the main next-previs feasibility test.
stages.focus: From whole building to architectural detail.
stages.confidence: Proposed camera path; clearance/framing not yet rendered

stages.title: The approved blade passage
stages.state: Exact approved completed model, path, blade and colour handling.
stages.camera: Replay the approved 0–3.000 s approach without retiming or recalibration.
stages.transition: At maximum blade cover, real footage is already moving behind the occluder.

stages.title: Real Anna Athina, close
stages.state: Real façade-side bridge; blade clears and native video takes over.
stages.transition: Play 3.080 seconds naturally, never scroll-seek every video frame.

stages.title: The completed-project reveal
stages.state: Real wider drone reveal, then ordinary project content.
stages.transition: Clean real-to-real cut; 3.240 seconds to breathe.

coordinateSystem: Frozen model metres; X grid 1→11, Y RL, Z A→E. Positive Z is the street-facing approach side; not a compass claim.
finalPath: Frozen walk path starts at p=[0.6,6.2,33], target=[19,7.5,26], vFOV=48 degrees. Its timing is untouched.
